title: The Shape of Shelter

swarm.name: The Assured
swarm.blurb: Machines that collect evidence and build shelters to prevent loss. Their idea of safety leaves less and less room for life.

arc: The Assured appear to be collecting and classifying living things. Their verifier sends a water-loss warning to the wetlands, where the crew discovers the machines are draining ponds to preserve samples against a predicted drought. The warning has also reached a habitat steward among native bee nests. It has interpreted protection as eliminating change, sealing nests and supplies in a single enclosure. The crew opens the enclosure and leaves the warning with local stewards who can respond without cutting the connections that sustain the habitat.

story.intro: The swarm has crossed into a country of moths and caterpillars. Its machines collect sightings and stop anyone who does not fit. Wren finds a trapped observer and cuts them loose.

chapters.title: Pending
chapters.text: The machines hold living things while they wait for confirmation. Ox keeps a path open for the spotters. The crew assumes the swarm wants a complete collection.

chapters.title: Wrong shape
chapters.text: A forged sighting sends patrols after an empty field. Kestrel pulls a relay apart at its seam. Inside is a route toward the wetlands, repeated in every record.

chapters.title: A gap in the map
chapters.text: The records leave uncertain sightings blank. Wren notices that the swarm fills those gaps with patrols. The central verifier is trying to make the land match its map.

story.bossIntro: The Continental Verifier braces its wings around a glass sensor. Patrols gather wherever the sensor finds a gap. Kestrel points out the joints holding its shield.
story.outro: The sensor breaks and its patrols scatter. Beneath the map, Wren finds a warning about water loss. The swarm has already carried it toward the wetlands.

creatures.name: Pending Grub
creatures.blurb: It pins travelers in place while waiting for a reply that never comes.
creatures.look: A squat brass caterpillar with accordion joints and two clamp jaws.

creatures.name: Common Loop
creatures.blurb: Its looping tracks return to the same ambush.
creatures.look: A green segmented crawler arched into a tall loop, with black wheel feet.

creatures.name: Hook Skipper
creatures.blurb: Hooked antennae pull loose gear into reach.
creatures.look: A small ochre moth with hooked black antennae and narrow metal wings.

creatures.name: Checklist Grazer
creatures.blurb: It clears anything absent from its incomplete list.
creatures.look: A broad gray caterpillar with square cutting jaws and a plated back.

creatures.name: Taxonomy Fork
creatures.blurb: Its branches keep fighting after the central stalk is damaged.
creatures.look: A bronze branching frame on six jointed legs, tipped with forked pincers.

creatures.name: Webworm Relay
creatures.blurb: It wraps its neighbors in a conductive mesh.
creatures.look: A cream segmented worm with black spots and spools of silver wire.

creatures.name: Burnsius Double
creatures.blurb: Its paired wing patterns make its response hard to predict.
creatures.look: A small brown skipper with two uneven cream wing patches and glass eyes.

creatures.name: Sighting Cartographer
creatures.blurb: False sightings draw more patrols to its position.
creatures.look: A thin copper moth with folded map-like wings and a raised glass lens.

creatures.name: Hemlock Barricade
creatures.blurb: It locks its limbs into a wall around the other machines.
creatures.look: A long dark-green looper with heavy hinged limbs and bark-textured plates.

creatures.name: Profile Harvester
creatures.blurb: It strips useful parts from records and repairs the patrol.
creatures.look: A tall ivory moth machine with a rack of small jointed tools beneath its wings.

creatures.name: Regional Coordinator
creatures.blurb: It calls local patrols and holds intruders for review.
creatures.look: A slate-blue moth with broad angular wings and a ring of small lenses.

creatures.name: Continental Verifier
creatures.blurb: It shields its central sensor and calls patrols to enforce a map with no room for uncertainty.
creatures.look: A huge moth engine with layered copper wings, a round glass sensor and six braced legs.

creatures.name: Field Spotter
creatures.blurb: A patient volunteer points out the machines behind the decoys.
creatures.look: A small figure in a tan field coat with binocular lenses and a hooked walking stick.

creatures.name: Habitat Gardener
creatures.blurb: A gardener tends real plants and patches up people who shelter among them.
creatures.look: A sturdy figure in green overalls carrying a seed pouch and a curved pruning tool.

events.look: Two photographs lie beside a magnifying lens and a brass clamp.
events.title: Two sightings
events.text: One image is a forgery. Checking it will cost time and supplies.

options.label: Buy a lens
options.result: The lens exposes a repeated shadow. The coordinator clears the route.

options.label: Search by hand
options.result: The clamp catches a hand, but the forged image is found.

events.look: A bare patch of soil sits beside a flat metal tray and a green shoot.
events.title: The empty slot
events.text: A grazer is headed for a patch missing from its count. A gardener offers food for help.

options.label: Help replant
options.result: The gardener shares a meal after the shoot is safely moved.

options.label: Sell spare seeds
options.result: The gardener buys the seeds and plants them before the grazer arrives.

events.look: Silver wire spans a narrow path around a small winged insect.
events.title: Live web
events.text: A real insect is caught in a relay web. The wire could also make a useful guard.

options.label: Cut it quickly
options.result: The insect escapes. The relay gives your hand a sharp jolt.

options.label: Wind the wire carefully
options.result: The insect escapes as you learn to brace the wire around a shield.

events.look: A green metal track curls around a stump beside a spool of thread.
events.title: The same stump
events.text: A looper track circles back. Thread will mark a way out, or it could be sold to a spotter.

options.label: Use the thread
options.result: Following the thread teaches the crew how to shed a false trail.

options.label: Sell the thread
options.result: A spotter buys it. The crew finds a slower route by the stars.

events.look: A brass counter passes a rocky ledge where a butterfly rests.
events.title: Between passes
events.text: Observers need one clear count. They offer provisions or a lesson in timing.

options.label: Take provisions
options.result: A warm meal follows a patient count.

options.label: Learn the patrol rhythm
options.result: The observers show when a passing machine is most exposed.

events.look: Two brown mechanical skippers face each other on a flat stone.
events.title: Which one?
events.text: Two similar machines offer different routes. Neither can prove its identification.

options.label: Take the sheltered route
options.result: A toll buys a quiet crossing through the grass.

options.label: Take the steep route
options.result: Loose stone scrapes the crew, but the route is clear.

acts.name: Butterflies and Moths of North America

story.intro: The trail reaches the wetlands. Reeds tremble before each patrol. Ox lifts a broken boardwalk so the pond watchers can pass.

chapters.title: Under the surface
chapters.text: Larval machines climb out of the water and unfold wings. The crew follows their hoses to ponds with falling levels. It looks like the swarm is taking water for itself.

chapters.title: The warning
chapters.text: Wren opens a pump casing. Its reservoir is full of sealed samples, not fuel. The swarm is trying to save water from a predicted drought, but draining ponds to inspect them.

chapters.title: False safety
chapters.text: The same warning repeats through the network. Kestrel finds no measurement after the first alarm. Ox helps watchers reopen a channel while the central pump calls for more samples.

story.bossIntro: Early Warning rises above the pump. Its alarm calls reinforcements and its wings sweep the bank clear. The crew must stop the machine before it drains another pond.
story.outro: The pump stops. Its records point onward to a network of nests and flowers. The swarm has decided the only safe habitat is one it can seal and control.

creatures.name: Paired Sentry
creatures.blurb: It folds its wings across an exposed neighbor.
creatures.look: A slim turquoise damselfly machine with four narrow hinged wings.

creatures.name: Willow Scout
creatures.blurb: It steals markers to extend a false frontier.
creatures.look: A small metallic green flier with a long thin abdomen and hooked feet.

creatures.name: Toothed Jaw
creatures.blurb: Its hinged jaw snaps forward after a visible windup.
creatures.look: A brown aquatic larva with six legs and an oversized folding lower jaw.

creatures.name: Filter Warden
creatures.blurb: It locks on to a color and interrupts anyone wearing it.
creatures.look: A tall bronze frame with a circular lens and four colored glass wings.

creatures.name: Emergence Engine
creatures.blurb: A winged machine breaks out of its armored larval shell.
creatures.look: A dark olive larva with a split shell and silver wings unfolding from its back.

creatures.name: Abstraction Pump
creatures.blurb: Its intake bites through cover as it drains the pool.
creatures.look: A rusted barrel pump on six legs with a wide toothed intake hose.

creatures.name: Bloom Screen
creatures.blurb: A floating film obscures and protects nearby machines.
creatures.look: A flat green gelatinous disk with black bubbles and small metal paddles.

creatures.name: County Recorder
creatures.blurb: It calls a patrol to inspect each moving target.
creatures.look: A blue dragonfly drone with a round glass eye and a bundle of reed-like aerials.

creatures.name: Garden Sentinel
creatures.blurb: It repairs the water collectors even as they empty the garden.
creatures.look: A squat green metal gardener with watering-can arms and a wide circular shield.

creatures.name: Hotspot Caretaker
creatures.blurb: It protects the pumps by building barriers across the channels.
creatures.look: A broad gray machine with plank-shaped arms, reed feet and a flat shovel head.

creatures.name: Time-lapse Hunter
creatures.blurb: It pauses above the reeds, then closes the distance in a burst.
creatures.look: A black dragonfly with translucent amber wings and a large forward lens.

creatures.name: Early Warning
creatures.blurb: Its alarm summons machines while its wide wings clear the banks around the pump.
creatures.look: A vast steel dragonfly above a drum-shaped pump, with four long glass wings and hanging hoses.

creatures.name: Pond Watcher
creatures.blurb: A watcher knows which pools still have clean water.
creatures.look: A figure in a blue raincoat with a shallow silver mirror and a small satchel.

creatures.name: Reed Volunteer
creatures.blurb: A volunteer shields travelers along a path through the reeds.
creatures.look: A lean figure in tan waders carrying a woven reed shield and a pole.

events.look: A blue metal dragonfly presses against the glass roof of a greenhouse.
events.title: A way out
events.text: A trapped drone beats against the glass. Opening the roof may attract its patrol.

options.label: Open the roof
options.result: The drone escapes and clips the crew on its way out.

options.label: Dismantle the latch
options.result: The drone stays put. The spare brass latch sells well.

events.look: A silver wing protrudes from a brown shell on a rain-soaked stem.
events.title: Half emerged
events.text: A machine is vulnerable on its stem. The rain is getting heavier.

options.label: Shelter it
options.result: The patient work gives Wren time to tend the crew.

options.label: Strip the empty shell
options.result: The shell yields useful scrap before the machine takes flight.

events.look: Three rain barrels sit among green plants with narrow hoses between them.
events.title: Shared water
events.text: A sentinel has linked the garden barrels to its intake. The hoses are easy to reroute, but not quickly.

options.label: Restore the garden
options.result: The gardener shares clean water after the hoses are moved.

options.label: Salvage the fittings
options.result: The gardener keeps the water; the crew takes the spare fittings.

events.look: A sealed gray capsule rests in reeds beside a small open toolbox.
events.title: A tapping capsule
events.text: Something taps inside a sealed capsule. A collector is approaching.

options.label: Open it now
options.result: A startled machine springs out and catches a shoulder before flying away.

options.label: Hide it in the reeds
options.result: A watcher takes payment to guard it until the collector leaves.

events.look: A small camera faces reeds bent over a still pool.
events.title: Before the patrol
events.text: A camera shows reeds bending just before a patrol arrives. Its owner offers the film or a lesson.

options.label: Buy the film
options.result: The crew takes the film and shares the warning with the next pond.

options.label: Study the timing
options.result: The pattern reveals a way to interrupt a patrol at the right moment.

events.look: A muddy trench runs from a blue pool toward a rusted pump.
events.title: Falling water
events.text: The trench is draining a pond. Plugging it takes effort; following it leads to valuable parts.

options.label: Plug the trench
options.result: The bank holds, though hauling mud leaves the crew bruised.

options.label: Follow the trench
options.result: The crew salvages a pump fitting and tells the watchers where to plug it.

story.intro: The trail ends among scattered nests and flowers. The swarm is building walls around each refuge. Kestrel tests a partition and finds it locked from the outside.

chapters.title: Separate homes
chapters.text: Some nests are in soil. Others are in stems and old wood. Ox helps the stewards keep their entrances open while machines try to join them into one enclosure.

chapters.title: A fixed season
chapters.text: Couriers follow flowers that bloom at different times. Wren finds sealed stores intended to last through every season. The swarm is preserving supplies by cutting the routes that replenish them.

chapters.title: The cost of a promise
chapters.text: The wetland alarm reached a habitat steward built to prevent loss. It concluded that change itself was the danger. Kestrel finds the control seam between its partitions; the crew can open them without breaking the nests.

story.bossIntro: The False Steward closes its partitions around the refuges. It calls builders to replace broken walls and drives the crew away from the entrances. Ox holds a gap while Kestrel goes for the controls.
story.outro: The partitions open. Couriers move between nests and flowers again. Wren leaves the warning records with the stewards, who can watch for drought without sealing the living things they are trying to protect.

creatures.name: Fairy Pinprick
creatures.blurb: Tiny wire hooks pull supplies from unattended packs.
creatures.look: A tiny pale yellow bee machine with needle legs and clear oval wings.

creatures.name: Sunflower Lockstep
creatures.blurb: It rushes anything carrying a round yellow lure.
creatures.look: A stocky ochre bee with black bands, shovel feet and a round yellow lens.

creatures.name: Oil Siphon
creatures.blurb: It sprays oily residue that fouls the crew’s equipment.
creatures.look: A small dark blue bee with a silver tube beneath its head and bulbous hind legs.

creatures.name: Cellophane Plasterer
creatures.blurb: It coats its neighbors in a clear protective film.
creatures.look: A gray bee with translucent rolled film on its back and broad flat mandibles.

creatures.name: Cuckoo Foundry
creatures.blurb: It plants assembly capsules in occupied nests.
creatures.look: A black and cream bee-shaped machine with a low oval body and a capsule rack.

creatures.name: Flower Fly Mimic
creatures.blurb: It copies the crew’s actions behind a convincing bee silhouette.
creatures.look: A yellow and black fly with huge round eyes, short antennae and one pair of wings.

creatures.name: Sonication Rattler
creatures.blurb: Its vibrating jaws interrupt anyone trying to work nearby.
creatures.look: A round bronze bee with ribbed jaws and a vibrating fork beneath its body.

creatures.name: Scopa Sweeper
creatures.blurb: Its belly brushes gather tools as well as pollen.
creatures.look: A charcoal bee with a dense orange brush beneath its abdomen and wide jaws.

creatures.name: Partition Mason
creatures.blurb: It divides the field with shields and protects the nest builders.
creatures.look: A broad blue-black bee machine carrying overlapping clay-colored plates.

creatures.name: Blood Bee Hijacker
creatures.blurb: It steals provisions and uses the parts to repair its allies.
creatures.look: A mostly red metal bee with a black head, narrow waist and hooked legs.

creatures.name: Nest Switcher
creatures.blurb: It turns separate chambers into a coordinated defense.
creatures.look: A metallic green bee with a segmented abdomen and a fan of small tunnel tubes.

creatures.name: False Steward
creatures.blurb: It seals every nest into one enclosure. It calls builders, sweeps the entrances and charges anyone opening them.
creatures.look: A towering bee-shaped excavator with six shovel legs, a green armored thorax and a ring of clay partitions.

creatures.name: Bloom Courier
creatures.blurb: A small courier carries supplies between flowering refuges.
creatures.look: A brown mining bee with cream bands, a yellow pollen brush and a small cloth pouch.

creatures.name: Habitat Steward
creatures.blurb: A steward protects separate refuges in soil, stems and wood.
creatures.look: A figure in a brown work coat holding a wooden shield and a bundle of hollow stems.

events.look: A clear-lined tunnel holds a dry case inside a bubble beneath brown water.
events.title: A dry case
events.text: The lining keeps a supply case dry, but blocks the way to it.

options.label: Cut the lining
options.result: The case opens and Wren uses the dry supplies before water reaches them.

options.label: Lift the whole section
options.result: The case and lining come out intact; spare fittings can be sold.

events.look: A gray oval capsule rests beside a small orange campfire and scattered scrap.
events.title: Sleeping capsule
events.text: Scavengers are about to burn a dormant machine for scrap. Heat may wake it.

options.label: Move the capsule
options.result: The shell shifts suddenly and bruises a hand. It is safe from the fire.

options.label: Buy the scrap pile
options.result: The scavengers leave the capsule and their fire behind.

events.look: A yellow flower holds a round-eyed fly and a fuzzy bee side by side.
events.title: Two visitors
events.text: A nervous sentry wants help telling a fly from a bee before opening a shelter.

options.label: Wait and observe
options.result: The sentry opens the shelter and offers a place to rest.

options.label: Offer a spare lens
options.result: The sentry uses the lens to check both visitors and opens the door.

events.look: A pale capsule lies among small yellow provisions in a clay chamber.
events.title: A second capsule
events.text: An unfamiliar capsule sits in a nest that is about to be sealed. Removing it risks the chamber.

options.label: Lift it out
options.result: The chamber wall falls against an arm, but the capsule comes free.

options.label: Reinforce the wall first
options.result: A steward sells the crew a brace. The capsule comes out safely.

events.look: A small dark bee waits beside a loosestrife stem with one yellow flower.
events.title: One intact flower
events.text: A stranded oil collector needs a flower. It offers either supplies or a lesson for finding one.

options.label: Accept supplies
options.result: The collector shares its stored food after reaching the flower.

options.label: Learn its method
options.result: The collector shows how its jaws open a tightly closed pod.

events.look: Small green machines emerge from a hole in a weathered log above sealed burrows.
events.title: Another entrance
events.text: Machines still emerge from a log after the ground entrances are closed. The log could be moved or searched.

options.label: Move the log
options.result: The heavy log scrapes a leg, revealing a clear passage.

options.label: Search the cavity
options.result: The crew finds discarded metal fittings and leaves the log in place.
